error.cookiesHint: Make sure you are signed in to YouTube Music in %1, or change the browser in the widget settings.
list.noOwnPlaylists: You don't have playlists of your own yet. Create one in YouTube Music.
notice.signinOpened: Opened the sign-in page in %1. Sign in there, then try again.
notice.skippedUnknown: Skipped a track that couldn't be played.
notice.cookiesHint: It may play with your YouTube account.
settings.title: Settings
settings.fadeInHint: Each song starts quietly and rises.
settings.fadeOutHint: Each song fades away at its end.
settings.peakMixHint: Like a DJ: at a song's climax, crossfade into the next song's climax. Each song plays from its build-up through its best part. Downloads the songs' audio to mix them.
settings.crossfadeHint: How long the two climaxes overlap.
settings.autoplayHint: When the queue runs out, keep playing songs recommended for the last one.
settings.playbackCookiesHint: Send your browser's YouTube login when playing, for members-only songs and private uploads.
settings.browserHint: Change it with: omarchy bar set io.github.symonbaikov.ytmusic-mpv browser <name>
settings.coversHint: Show covers for the playing song and in lists.
settings.barTitleHint: Show the playing song's title next to the icon.
notice.backupSource: “%1” came from a backup source (%2): YouTube's usual stream didn't open.
notice.youtubeFailing: YouTube isn't letting songs play (%1). Updating yt-dlp usually fixes it: omarchy update
settings.mirrorsHint: If YouTube itself won't play a song, get it from independent mirrors (Invidious, Piped). They see which song is played, never your login.
offer.title: YouTube won't play “%1”
offer.body: Backup mirrors can fetch it from independent servers (Invidious, Piped). They see which song you play, never your login.
offer.notifyBody: YouTube isn't serving “%1”. Open the player to try backup sources.
update.title: Update available: %1
update.notifyTitle: A fix for YouTube Music is available
update.notifyBody: Version %1 is out. Open the player to update.
settings.updatesHint: Once a day, and right away when songs stop playing, ask this plugin's GitHub repository whether a newer version is out.
explore.title: Explore
explore.subtitle: New releases, charts, moods and search
download.title: Download “%1”
list.downloadsHint: Songs you saved, playing from your disk
list.emptyDownloads: Nothing downloaded yet. Use the download button beside a song.
download.coverHint: Embed the cover in the file (MP3, M4A, FLAC) and show it in Downloads.
sc.setupBody: Sign in to SoundCloud, open your profile, copy its link from the address bar and press Paste link (or type your name below). Your likes and playlists show up here. The browser is the one the plugin reads (%1), so private likes work too.
sp.setupBody: Spotify only lets a personal app read your library, and its owner needs Premium (Spotify's 2026 rules). Once: open the dashboard, create an app with the Web API, add the redirect URI http://127.0.0.1/callback, and paste its Client ID here. Songs play from their YouTube Music match: Spotify's own audio is locked to Spotify's apps.
sp.connectBody: Sign in to Spotify in your browser to let this player read your playlists and Liked Songs.
setup.pasteNothing: Copy your %1 profile link first (the address bar on your profile), then press Paste link
scrobble.approve: Allow it on Last.fm's page in your browser
scrobble.connected: Connected: songs you play are scrobbled
scrobble.lastfmHelp: Last.fm needs an API account of your own (free, a minute): create one, then paste its API key and shared secret here. Connect opens Last.fm to allow it.
scrobble.listenbrainzHelp: Paste your user token from ListenBrainz's settings page.
report.opened: The report is open in your browser with everything filled in: just press Submit.
report.troubleBody: Nothing could play this time. Send the details to the developer in one click: the report is written for you, without your songs, accounts or paths.
report.notifyBody: Nothing could play. Open the player: one click sends the details to the developer.
report.updateHint: Updating yt-dlp often fixes this: omarchy update
cloud.title: Add your music files
cloud.body: Play the music in a folder on this computer, on your music server (Navidrome, Jellyfin, Plex) or in your own storage. Folders and albums come with their covers.
cloud.noRclone: Cloud storage goes through rclone, which isn't installed yet.
cloud.addHint: This computer, Navidrome, Jellyfin, Plex, S3, Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, SFTP, SMB, WebDAV
cloud.noRemotes: rclone has no remotes yet. Pick a kind of storage above, or set one up with `rclone config`.
cloud.hint.drive: Your browser opens Google's sign-in. The player only gets read access.
cloud.hint.s3: Amazon S3, or anything that speaks S3 (Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, MinIO, Wasabi): leave Endpoint empty for Amazon.
cloud.hint.sftp: A server over SSH. Without a password, your SSH key is used.
cloud.hint.webdav: Nextcloud, ownCloud, a NAS, or any WebDAV server.
cloud.hint.remote: A remote you already set up in rclone.
cloud.name: NAME (OPTIONAL)
cloud.waiting: Finish signing in in your browser…
full.lyricsNone: No lyrics for this song yet.
notes.approx: Chords heard from the audio: a good start for learning, not always exact.
notes.fetching: Getting the song's audio to hear its chords…
notes.searching: Looking for sheet music and tabs…
notes.noScores: Songsterr has no tabs for this song. Try MuseScore or Ultimate Guitar:
settings.pauseFadeHint: Pausing fades the song away instead of cutting it off, and playing again brings it back the same way.
services.title: Services
services.hint: Pick the services you want as tabs. YouTube Music and My Music are always there.
services.about.sp: Your Spotify library, played from YouTube Music.
services.about.sc: Your SoundCloud likes and playlists, and its search.
services.about.cl: Your own music: a folder on this computer, Navidrome / Subsonic, Jellyfin, Plex, S3, Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, SFTP, SMB, WebDAV, FTP.
services.about.rd: About 50,000 internet radio stations: top, genres, your country, search, favorites.
services.about.pc: Podcasts from Apple Podcasts' directory or any feed: subscribe, new episodes, and each one goes on where you stopped.
services.soon: Bandcamp blocks apps from playing its music for now, and Jamendo needs a key of your own: they may come later.
services.about.mc: DJ mixes and radio shows from Mixcloud: popular in each genre, and search.
services.about.au: Independent artists on Audius, free to stream: trending by genre, and search.
services.about.dz: Your Deezer favorites and playlists, Deezer's charts and search, played from YouTube Music.
dz.setupBody: Sign in to Deezer, open your profile (your picture, top right), copy its link from the address bar and press Paste link. Your favorite tracks and playlists show up here, with Deezer's charts. Your profile has to be public.
pc.searchField: Search podcasts, or paste a feed link…
pc.subscribed: Subscribed: its new episodes are in New episodes
cloud.hint.local: A folder on this computer: played straight from its files, offline.
cloud.hint.subsonic: Navidrome, or any server with the Subsonic API (Airsonic, Gonic …): its address, your user name and password. Only a token is kept, never the password.
cloud.hint.jellyfin: Your Jellyfin server: its address, your user name and password. Only the token Jellyfin gives is kept.
cloud.hint.plex: Your browser opens Plex's sign-in; allow it, and your server with music is found by itself.
ai.settingHint: Your AI agent (Claude, Codex or OpenCode) makes you a mix from what you listen to, again each day. It is sent a short summary of your taste: the artists and songs you play and like.
ai.title: AI Mix
ai.makeHint: Songs picked for you by your AI from what you listen to
ai.body: Your AI agent looks at what you play, finish, skip and like across every service, and picks songs you'll probably love: some close to your favorites, most of them new to you. Each is checked on YouTube Music.
ai.wish: WHAT ARE YOU IN THE MOOD FOR? (OPTIONAL: "EPIC FOR WORK", "CALMER" …)
ai.goFirst: Turn on and make my AI Mix
ai.privacy: Sent to your AI agent: the artists and songs you play most, your likes and the artists you skip. Your history itself stays on this computer.
ai.notifyBody: %1 songs picked for you from what you listen to.
